bug_fix_verified.original_issue: Users with 'Redactie Verantwoordelijke' role had Calendar permissions (View, Create, Edit, Delete) but could not edit or delete shows from the calendar
bug_fix_verified.root_cause: (1) Permission middleware mapped /api/shows to 'shows' feature but not 'calendar', (2) endpoint-level 'require_admin' dependencies blocked non-admin users regardless of role permissions
bug_fix_verified.fix_applied: (a) Added FEATURE_ALIASES so 'shows' and 'calendar' permissions are interchangeable, (b) Middleware sets 'request.state.permission_approved = True' when it approves, (c) Legacy auth dependencies check this flag and skip legacy role check if middleware approved, (d) /api/auth/me/permissions merges alias permissions
bug_fix_verified.verification_result: All tests pass - fix is working correctly
